inventory_audit.rationale: Read the full dissertation page text, all7chapters and AppsA–G, frontmatter,Dutch summary,bibliography,acknowledgements; reconciled all41legacy groups to atomic scientific assertions and individual published numerical constituents. Results from cited studies and proposed future studies were not recast as original completed experiments. Original broad power/identification/scale-invariance claims remain visible separately from their narrower source evidence. No manuscript or live production effects were read for this specification. Headline classification was independently reconsidered against original chapter abstracts and discussion emphasis:26 principal claims with all990 previous atomic targets retained. Explicit source parents/components preserve full scientific contrast inventories and dependence; no scalar aggregate or independent-study count is fabricated.

page_reading_audit.method: Python reads of /tmp/schwabe.txt split on formfeed in bounded page groups. Initial truncated groups were re-read for omitted pages17–21 and100–102. PDF identity/page count checked independently; vector source-target grid retained with extraction bounds. This is not a rendered manuscript review.
